VKS.description:
The VKS, also sometimes called the VSSK, is a bullpup straight-pull bolt-action sniper rifle chambered for 12.7x55mm STS-130. The weapon uses an integrally mounted suppressor and is designed for situations requiring more penetration than is offered by the 9x39mm subsonic round from the VSS Vintorez sniper rifle. It has been in service since 2004 with Zarovian special forces.

Model submitted by Mysterious Modeler X
VKS.name: VKS

M1903.description: A Grand Federation bolt action rifle designed in 1903. The M1903 since its days from The Great War and the Second World War has seen use in the modern era as a competitive sporting rifle, collecters piece and as a military drill rifle.
M1903.name: M1903

DRAGUNOV SVDS.description: A paratrooper version of the SVD rifle, with a light frame and folding stock. Semi-automatic with 10 round magazine, but suffers from poor recoil recovery.
DRAGUNOV SVDS.name: DRAGUNOV SVDS

M107.description:
The M82A1 is one of the most prolific anti-materiel rifles ever produced. It is semi-automatic and magazine-fed, allowing it to put out rounds incredibly quickly for the caliber. The A1M variant includes numerous upgrades to the muzzle brake, a rear grip with a monopod socket, and improved accessory rails.

Extremely high damage with a high rate of fire, but cumbersome handling and recoil that is ill-suited for that firerate.

Big whoop, I'm using a Barrett .50 cal. I could kill a building.

Model submitted by Rialag
M107.name: M107

STEYR SCOUT.description:
A sniper rifle with a design focus on portability and practical accuracy at midrange rather than raw firepower and long-range performance.

Has extremely comfortable handling and a high rate of fire for a marksman weapon, but punishes missed headshots more than other similar weapons.
STEYR SCOUT.name: STEYR SCOUT

KEK-50.description: A custom Tec platform Anti-Materiel Rifle chambered in .50 BMG. Not only is it full auto, the recoil wants to rip it right from your hands! April Fools!
KEK-50.name: KEK-50

M110A1.description:
An Eisenmarkian Compact Semi Automatic Sniper System (CSASS) made for use by Grand Federation, developed from the M417 platform and bearing similarities with M28 GDMR.
It's able to instantly kill to the head at any range while still carrying a punch, though, slower velocity and rapid firing will make landing hits difficult at longer ranges.

Model submitted by Rialag.
M110A1.name: M110A1

attachmentModifiers.info:
A larger 20 round magazine!
Doubles your magazine capacity at the cost of handling, mobility and reload time!

COMP 1022.description:
A custom body kit for the R-10/22 rifle designed for competition shooting. Fires a specialty high-velocity ammunition.

Extremely low recoil and excellent handling, but extremely poor performance to the torso.

Model submitted by Vic
COMP 1022.name: COMP 1022

THE FIX.description:
A lightweight bolt-action sporting rifle chambered in the unusual 8.6 Blackout subsonic cartridge.

Extremely good handling with a somewhat unique damage profile to compensate for extremely low velocity.

Model submitted by Vic
THE FIX.name: THE FIX

CS/LR-3.description:
The CS/LR-3 is a bolt-action sniper chambered in 5.8x42mm DBU-141 which, paired with a free-floating barrel design, improves accuracy significantly compared to earlier snipers used by the People's Liberation Army.

High muzzle velocity and a fast bolting speed, but relatively low damage compared to other snipers.

Community submitted model.
CS/LR-3.name: CS/LR-3
